title: 自我介紹
description: 介紹自己的基本資訊與背景

sentences.en: Allow me to introduce myself — my name is David, and I've been working as a software engineer for about seven years now.
sentences.zh: 請允許我自我介紹——我叫David，我做軟體工程師大約七年了。

sentences.en: I originally come from a small town in southern Taiwan, but I moved to Taipei for university and have been living here ever since.
sentences.zh: 我來自台灣南部的一個小鎮，但我因為上大學搬到台北，從那之後就一直住在這裡。

sentences.en: Although my major in college was business administration, I eventually found my true passion in graphic design, which is what I do now.
sentences.zh: 雖然我大學主修企業管理，但我最終在平面設計中找到了真正的熱情，這也是我現在的工作。

sentences.en: One thing you should know about me is that I'm the kind of person who genuinely enjoys meeting new people and hearing their stories.
sentences.zh: 關於我你應該知道的一件事是，我是那種真心喜歡認識新朋友、聽他們故事的人。

sentences.en: I'd describe myself as someone who is naturally curious about the world, which is probably why I ended up studying three different languages.
sentences.zh: 我會形容自己是一個對世界天生充滿好奇心的人，這大概就是為什麼我最後學了三種不同的語言。

sentences.en: Having graduated from university just two years ago, I'm still figuring out exactly where I want my career to go in the long run.
sentences.zh: 大學畢業才兩年，我還在摸索我的職業生涯長遠來看要往哪個方向發展。

sentences.en: In my spare time, which admittedly isn't as much as I'd like, I enjoy reading historical novels and experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在我的空閒時間裡——雖然說實話沒有我想要的那麼多——我喜歡閱讀歷史小說和在廚房裡嘗試新食譜。

sentences.en: What brought me to this industry in the first place was a childhood fascination with how technology could solve real-world problems.
sentences.zh: 最初讓我進入這個行業的是我小時候對科技如何解決現實問題的著迷。

sentences.en: I'm currently in the process of transitioning from a teaching career to the tech sector, which has been both challenging and incredibly rewarding.
sentences.zh: 我目前正在從教育事業轉型到科技領域，這個過程既充滿挑戰又非常有收獲。

sentences.en: As someone who has lived abroad for over a decade, I've come to appreciate the importance of cross-cultural communication in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 作為一個在國外生活了十多年的人，我深刻體會到跨文化溝通在日常生活中的重要性。

sentences.en: My family, which includes my parents and two younger sisters, has always been incredibly supportive of whatever path I've chosen to pursue.
sentences.zh: 我的家人，包括我的父母和兩個妹妹，一直都非常支持我選擇走的任何道路。

sentences.en: The reason I decided to learn English seriously is that I realized it would open up so many more opportunities for me both personally and professionally.
sentences.zh: 我決定認真學英文的原因是，我意識到它會在個人和職業上為我打開更多的機會。

sentences.en: If there's one thing that defines who I am, it would have to be my determination to keep improving myself no matter how difficult things get.
sentences.zh: 如果有一件事能定義我是誰，那就是無論事情變得多困難，我都要不斷提升自己的決心。

sentences.en: I've been told by my colleagues that my greatest strength is my ability to remain calm and focused even when we're facing tight deadlines.
sentences.zh: 我的同事告訴我，我最大的優點是即使在面對緊迫的期限時，也能保持冷靜和專注。

sentences.en: Prior to joining this company, I spent five years working at a startup where I learned how to wear many different hats at once.
sentences.zh: 在加入這家公司之前，我在一家新創公司工作了五年，在那裡我學會了同時身兼多職。

sentences.en: What motivates me on a daily basis is the belief that the work I'm doing can actually make a meaningful difference in people's lives.
sentences.zh: 每天激勵我的是一個信念：我所做的工作確實能為人們的生活帶來有意義的改變。

sentences.en: Growing up in a multilingual household, where my grandparents spoke Taiwanese and my parents spoke Mandarin, gave me an early appreciation for languages.
sentences.zh: 在一個多語言家庭中長大——我的祖父母說台語，父母說國語——讓我很早就對語言產生了興趣。

sentences.en: I consider myself to be a lifelong learner, which is why I'm always signing up for online courses and attending workshops in my free time.
sentences.zh: 我認為自己是一個終身學習者，這就是為什麼我總是在空閒時間報名線上課程和參加研討會。

sentences.en: To give you a bit of background, I studied abroad in Canada for two years, which is where I really developed my English speaking skills.
sentences.zh: 給你介紹一下我的背景，我在加拿大留學了兩年，那是我真正提升英語口說能力的地方。

sentences.en: People often describe me as an outgoing and approachable person, though I actually need quite a bit of alone time to recharge my energy.
sentences.zh: 人們常形容我是一個外向且平易近人的人，但實際上我需要相當多的獨處時間來恢復精力。

sentences.en: Since I started my own small business last year, I've learned more about management and leadership than I ever did in any classroom.
sentences.zh: 自從去年開始創業以來，我學到的管理和領導知識比我在任何課堂上學到的都多。

sentences.en: My goal for the next few years is to build up enough experience and skills to eventually transition into a leadership role within my organization.
sentences.zh: 我未來幾年的目標是累積足夠的經驗和技能，最終在組織中轉型為領導角色。

sentences.en: What I find most fulfilling about my current job is the opportunity to collaborate with talented people from all sorts of different backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 我覺得目前工作最有成就感的部分是有機會和來自各種不同背景的優秀人才合作。

sentences.en: I should mention that apart from my full-time job, I also volunteer at a local community center on weekends, teaching basic computer skills to seniors.
sentences.zh: 我應該提一下，除了全職工作之外，我週末也在當地的社區活動中心當志工，教年長者基本的電腦技能。

sentences.en: Ever since I was a child, I've had a deep love for music, which eventually led me to pursue a degree in music composition at university.
sentences.zh: 從小我就對音樂有很深的熱愛，這最終促使我在大學攻讀音樂作曲學位。

sentences.en: Honestly, if someone had told me ten years ago that I'd end up working in artificial intelligence, I would have laughed and said that's impossible.
sentences.zh: 老實說，如果十年前有人告訴我我最後會在人工智慧領域工作，我會笑著說那不可能。

sentences.en: The most important lesson I've learned throughout my career so far is that being open to feedback is essential for personal and professional growth.
sentences.zh: 到目前為止，我在職業生涯中學到的最重要的教訓是，對反饋保持開放態度對個人和職業成長至關重要。

sentences.en: While I wouldn't say I'm the most experienced person in my field, I do believe that my unique combination of skills sets me apart from others.
sentences.zh: 雖然我不會說我是這個領域中最有經驗的人，但我確實相信我獨特的技能組合讓我與眾不同。

sentences.en: Looking back on my journey, I'm grateful for all the detours and unexpected turns, because they ultimately shaped me into the person I am today.
sentences.zh: 回顧我的旅程，我感激所有的繞路和意想不到的轉折，因為它們最終塑造了今天的我。

sentences.en: I'm really excited to be here today because this is exactly the kind of environment where I feel I can contribute the most and continue to grow.
sentences.zh: 我今天來到這裡真的很興奮，因為這正是那種我覺得可以做出最大貢獻並持續成長的環境。
